profiles.notes: Reference machine. AcerGamingFunction is registered as a dynamic class; instance access needs elevation. GetGamingSysInfo returns static configuration here, not a sensor page: the same bytes came back across runs minutes apart while the CPU temperature moved and the fan speed changed, so no temperature is decoded from it. Keyboard colour is written through SetGamingRgbKb with a non-zero zone mask; SetGamingKBBacklight rejects every payload tried.
Same platform family as the AN16-41 with a larger chassis.
Single-zone or four-zone RGB depending on the SKU; the keyboard capability answer decides, not this file.
Aspire-derived board. WMI fan and mode control is present; the MUX switch is not.
Nitro V chassis with a 16-inch panel.
Predator fan ceilings are higher than the Nitro line; the plausibility bound has to allow for it.

Fallback for any Acer machine the table does not name. Deliberately permissive: a wrong ceiling only widens the plausibility bound, it never enables a feature. No sensor offsets are claimed because none have been confirmed on a machine this table does not name.
